fee_notes: Monthly Franchise Fee: greater of $1,000 or 1.5% of Gross Sales (base) plus 4% of Gross Sales (growth). Insurance and Marketing Fund Fee: greater of $500 or 1% of Gross Sales; increases to 1.5% if non-compliant. Optional CCC software: $1,545/month (One Innovate) or $1,295/month (One Perform). Central Review Fee: 0.5% of CMIP Gross Sales (up to 2%). Training: $299/year. Non-reporting: $750/month if late.
